name: Emanation (Fear)
scaffolding_intent: Emits fear particles around an entity and shifts its tint, showing that it is scared or worried

parameters.name: tint
parameters.description: RGB tint shift applied to entity pixels (additive)

parameters.name: tintSaturation
parameters.description: How strongly the tint is applied (0 = no tint, 1 = full tint)

correction_intent: Child attributed a wrong emotion to a character the scene shows scared, worried, or anxious (wide eyes, trembling, hiding, backing away, facing a threat). Target that character. Not for anger; that is P2e.
suggestion_intent: A character is visibly scared, worried, or anxious (wide eyes, hiding, backing away, facing a threat) and the child has not said so. Target that character. Requires a visible cue of fear.
